input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement has no insurance article; the only reference to "insurance" (p0051) is a cost pass-through to Licensee, not a coverage covenant. Licensor supplies and supports hosted Licensed Technology through which our market data and trading orders are transmitted (p0021, p0031, p0033), so it is a services/hosting vendor touching our data and falls squarely within the rule. Inserted a short insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (l) after p0159 at the playbook preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback flagged in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement contains none even though Licensor hosts the Licensed Technology and handles our order flow and trading data. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; if these limits exceed Licensor's current program, we can work to E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide certificates of insurance to Licensee on request.
